race.description: A Little Connection Goes A Long Way Provincial Mdn Plate
race.comment: VICTOR THE WARRIOR (13) was scratched from the Beaumont track on Monday. Caught the eye on debut last start over 1300m at Newcastle, winding up from well back in the field to finish just behind the placegetters. Will take a lot from that hit-out and the longer journey today is right up his alley. CLASSIC TWO (1) recorded his sixth minor placing from 15 runs, and the fourth in a row, when a fast-finishing second over 1450m on the Illawarra Grange circuit last time out. This looks a nice assignment but the habit of looking good without winning is a worry. NAVY SLIPPERS (8) closed hard to grab second here at this trip two back. Never travelled and was eased up last time in a run to put the pen through. Capable of winning on that effort two back. The lightly raced WAKING RESOURCES (3) has failed to impress in two runs this prep but strips fitter and deserves one more chance. Trapeze Artist first starter EL PABLO (11) placed in a recent trial here and is worth monitoring in betting.
